an4.38:1.1: Panuṇṇapaccekasacco bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭhesano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro vā patilīno ti vuccati.
an4.38:1.2: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti?
an4.38:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni, seyyathīdaṃ
an4.38:1.4: sassato loko ti vā asassato loko ti vā antavā loko ti vā anantavā loko ti vā; taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṇ ti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā; hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti Tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti vā; hoti ca na hoti ca Tathagato param maraṇā ti vā, n' eva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā.
an4.38:1.5: Sabbāni 'ssa tāni nuṇṇāni honti cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni.
an4.38:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti. 2.
an4.38:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭhesano hoti?
an4.38:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti bhavesanā pahīnā hoti brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā.
an4.38:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭhesano hoti. 3.
an4.38:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti?
an4.38:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatiparisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.38:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti. 4.
an4.38:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu patilīno hoti?
an4.38:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an4.38:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu patilīno hoti.
an4.38:4.4: Panuṇṇapaccekasacco bhikkhave bhikkhu samavayasaṭhesano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro patilīno ti vuccatīti. 5.
